texts.rules: 1. You can challenge Fate when your academy level reaches Lv.48.|2. If you are qualified, you get 5 free chances daily to challenge.|3. The highest damage in a day will be recorded into your personal damage rank.|4. Players will be rewarded based on the damage created after defeating each Valkyrie. |5. Players can challenge the next Valkyrie by defeating the current one.|6. The increment of Courage is calculated in each server every 22:00, before which the Fate needs to be closed for 2 minutes. |7. The more Lv.90 players in a server are, the more Courage will be increased. |8. The more challengers in a day are, the more damage to Valkyries will be, so will the Courage. |9. A Valkyrie can be defeated when the Courage increases to a certain amount. |10. A Milestone Event of a server is triggered every time a Valkyrie is defeated. |11. Your damage by raiding is the highest damage you created once in history. |12. Valkyries are immune to any controlling effect, but can be affected by debuffs like poison and armor reduction.|13.Fate is not available at 22:00 to 24:00 daily.
